title: After 25 years at Adobe, engineer laid off; now he is a driver
summary_full: A senior software engineer with twenty-five years at Adobe was laid off last year. He struggled to find new tech employment for a year after his dismissal. This led him to pursue a new career as a school bus driver for his local district. While his new role pays less, he finds contentment and supportive colleagues. His experience highlights challenges faced by experienced tech professionals in the current job market.
